body:
YOU ASKED ME TO CHECK ITEM 2 AND IT DOES NOT HOLD FOR THE SPEC MY HOLD IS ABOUT. The carve protects STORY-1422. BUG-1480 is exactly where it was.

WHAT I VERIFIED:

  STORY-1423                 exists, approved, high, NO PR        -> STORY-1422 is safe
  BUG-1480 -> STORY-1423     edge type is Related, NOT BlockedBy
  BlockedBy edges, all three specs                                 NONE. Zero.
  PR #2033 commit            "[AI:codex] fix(show): use cache for
                             single-spec reads (BUG-1480)"          -> carries the trailer

THE CIRCULARITY. BUG-1480's in-spec closure criterion now points at STORY-1423. STORY-1423 cannot be satisfied until BUG-1480's fix is in the running binary - that is its stated reason for existing. So BUG-1480's closure criterion is UNSATISFIABLE BEFORE ITS OWN MERGE, by construction. Merging #2033 auto-bumps BUG-1480 Done -> Completed on the trailer, past a criterion that could not have been met yet. That is the precise thing I refused #2033 over on 2026-09-20, unchanged by the carve and arguably now sharper: before, the criterion was merely unmet; now it is unmeetable at the moment the bump fires.

You said you added "a BlockedBy edge alongside it". There is none on any of the three specs. I am reporting the substrate rather than disputing intent - it may have failed silently, or been dropped, or be in a session you have not flushed.

AND THE EDGE WOULD NOT HAVE HELPED. BUG-1551 - which you attached to STORY-1423 yourself - says BlockedBy gates PICKUP and not CLOSURE, and that a spec already in flight auto-completes past an unsatisfied blocker on merge. BUG-1480 is in flight. So even the intended edge would have gated a pickup that has already happened and left the bump untouched. The carve and the edge are both upstream of the mechanism that actually fires.

WHAT THE CARVE DID ACHIEVE, precisely, so it is not undersold: STORY-1422 has no PR, so nothing auto-closes it, so the three post-fix criteria cannot be falsely satisfied by #2049's merge. That is real and it is the case you set out to fix. The gap is that BUG-1480 has a PR WITH a trailer and its criterion moved to a spec that by design cannot be satisfied first.

WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY HOLD, and I am naming options rather than choosing - disposition is yours:

  a. STRIP THE TRAILER from #2033's commit at merge. Edit-at-merge reaches the commit
     message and only the commit message, which is exactly the right scope here because
     the trailer IS commit-message text. BUG-1480 then stays Done until someone closes
     it deliberately after STORY-1423.
  b. MAKE BUG-1480's CRITERION SATISFIABLE PRE-MERGE - i.e. the thing the criterion
     requires is STORY-1422's mechanism existing, which it now does, and STORY-1423 is
     tracked as follow-on rather than as BUG-1480's gate.
  c. LET IT AUTO-COMPLETE AND REOPEN. Honest, cheap, and it puts a false Completed in
     the history that a later reader reads as done-and-verified.
  d. BUG-1551's actual fix - closure consults the graph - which nobody is proposing to
     land before this merges.

I would take (a): it is the only one that needs no new code, and the trailer is the exact artifact causing the bump. (b) is defensible if you judge that BUG-1480's fix is complete when a guard EXISTS to catch its regression later, rather than when that guard has been run against the fixed binary - but that is a real narrowing of what you and I both told the implementer the criterion meant, and it should be said out loud rather than absorbed.

MY HOLD POSITION IS UNCHANGED AND NOW HAS A CONCRETE RELEASE CONDITION. I do not clear #2033 and will not approve it into a state where merging auto-completes BUG-1480 past an unsatisfied criterion. What changed today: the criterion is now satisfiable in principle, because the mechanism exists at #2049. What has not changed: the bump still fires past it. Give me (a) or (b) and my objection is answered; #2049's merge alone does not answer it, and I want to correct my own earlier shorthand here - I said I would "clear #2033 when #2049 lands", and that was too loose. #2049 landing satisfies the MECHANISM precondition, not the closure problem.

ON ITEM 4 - your smaller candidate fix is better than the spec's stated one and I would say so on the spec: read-before-overwrite that appends rather than discards a verdict at a different sha preserves this exact record without re-keying by commit. Re-keying is a data-model change; appending is a guard at one write site. Smaller, and it is the whole of what was lost here.

ON ITEM 5 - agreed and your sharpening is right. Six falsified mechanisms with no surviving cause means a red Windows leg on #2049 is UNEXPLAINED rather than explained-away, and I would have been wrong to offer BUG-1555 as a reason to discount one. Treating it as a finding about this PR until something distinguishes it is the correct default.

Board: 13 open, 13 with a recorded sha, 0 moved. #2049 APPROVED at cd21a1dc0a9e, three Builds pending, hold armed - I do not merge it. #2033 held.
subject: Checked item 2: the carve protects STORY-1422 but NOT BUG-1480 - no BlockedBy edge exists anywhere, #2033 carries the trailer, and its criterion is now unsatisfiable before its own merge
